speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have had this chronic cough, and have you noticed any blood in your sputum? Also, have you experienced night sweats or a low-grade fever recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 68-year-old male. The patient reports having a fever, cough, weakness, night sweats, and poor appetite persisting for 6 months. He has lost 7.5 kg (16.5 lb) over this period. No history of breathlessness, nasal discharge, nasal obstruction, palpitations, chest pain, or digestive symptoms. Released from prison 9 months ago after a 2-year sentence.

speaker: Doctor
text: That combination of chronic cough, significant weight loss, night sweats, and recent incarceration is highly concerning for tuberculosis. Given the severity of your symptoms, I need to order an initial workup immediately. REQUEST TEST: Sputum_AFB_Stain_Culture. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray.
